description: Defines the TemplateField class used for dynamic field templates in SuiteCRM, including methods for HTML rendering, database schema generation, and field management.

classes.name: TemplateField
classes.description: A class representing a template for dynamic fields in SuiteCRM, with methods for rendering, database schema, and field management.

methods.name: get_html
methods.description: Returns HTML representation based on the current view context.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple properties of the object from an array.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML for edit view (not implemented).

methods.name: get_html_list
methods.description: Returns HTML for list view.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns HTML for detail view (not implemented).

methods.name: get_html_search
methods.description: Returns HTML for search view.

methods.name: is_required
methods.description: Checks if the field is required.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Returns the database column type for the field.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns the default value clause for SQL.

methods.name: get_db_required
methods.description: Returns the required/not null clause for SQL.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to add column in ALTER TABLE.

methods.name: get_db_delete_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop column in ALTER TABLE.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Generates SQL to modify column in ALTER TABLE.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array for the bean.

methods.name: convertBooleanValue
methods.description: Converts various boolean representations to true/false.

methods.name: get_dup_merge_def
methods.description: Sets duplicate merge related definitions.

methods.name: getDupMergeDomValue
methods.description: Returns the duplicate merge DOM value.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the object, setting default id if necessary.

methods.name: populateFromRow
methods.description: Populates object properties from a database row.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates object properties from POST request data.

methods.name: applyVardefRules
methods.description: Placeholder for applying vardef rules.

methods.name: get_additional_defs
methods.description: Returns additional field definitions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the field via the provided DynamicField object.

methods.name: get_field_name
methods.description: Helper to get the proper field name for a module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field object and updates search fields if needed.
